description: **v0.1.0 — first public release.** The Kimi-K3 cooperation harness, with native grok subagent freight: guided first-run setup, `arcus init` agent-house scaffold, `.arcus` config semantics, iris companion seam.
**Repo-self references restored** — manual-update message names the GitHub Releases URL; SECURITY.md links the private-advisory form; README has the clone URL.

**Identity sweep** — user-visible command spellings now say `arcus` (login/setup/wrap/…), home paths point to ~/.arcus/, trust warning + agent descriptions + billing copy re-voice to Arcus Build; xAI entitlement wording stays factual.

**Iris TUI companion seam** — session-cached detect (pointer file then PATH); shortcuts-bar `dash` hint only when present; Ctrl+Shift+D opens `iris dash` in a new OS terminal (never in-process); spawn failure surfaces as a toast.
**Doctor header re-voice** — human doctor output header is `Arcus Doctor` (was `Grok Doctor`).
**Setup wizard hardening** — atomic config.toml write (temp+rename); dry-run creates no dirs; --force re-runs past done state; [agent] setup_on_first_run typed (no unrecognized-key warn).

**First-run setup wizard + `arcus setup`** — auto-guided TUI when no credentials resolve (K3 provider, Grok rail, Iris pointer); hard guards for headless/CI/disable-config/state; `setup --managed` for team managed config; never auto-fires on `-p`/piped.

**ARCUS_* env identity** — product env vars use ARCUS_* primary with GROK_* silent legacy aliases (HOME, DEFAULT_MODEL, SYSTEM_PROMPT_LABEL, AUTH_*, SHELL, CAMPAIGNS, CLI_*, managed-config); XAI_* provider keys unchanged; default home ~/.arcus.
**SessionStart additionalContext** — SessionStart hooks emitting hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext inject into session context; .arcus/hooks discovery parity with .grok/hooks.

**Binary rename to `arcus`** — public CLI is `arcus` (argv0 also accepts `arcus-build`, `grok`, `agent`); version output names arcus; doctor PATH-collision check for the crates.io Lua-linter name clash.
**Default system-prompt label** is `Arcus Build` (overridable per-model / env).
**Auto-update hard-off** — fork never self-updates to upstream; update surface points at the arcus-build GitHub Releases page; xAI reinstall hints purged.

**`arcus init`** — offline install of the embedded cooperation harness into a git repo, with ownership-aware `--refresh`/`--force`, lattice default-on, hooks default-on (`--no-hooks` opt-out), and global hooks-paths registration.
**.arcus semantics** — fork-native `.arcus` repo config dir (skills/commands, rules, hooks, workflows, agents, plugins) with `.grok` kept as legacy fallback at every surface.
**Dual-rail auth** — BYOK (XAI_API_KEY or per-model env_key / base_url) works with no OAuth grant; not hard-walled behind interactive login.
**Windows tests** — `parse_login_env_capture` tests cfg-gated to match their unix-only helper.
**Honest identity** — the system prompt no longer hardcodes "released by xAI"; identity comes wholly from `system_prompt_label` (per-model overridable).
**Arcus crescent** welcome logo — geometric braille moon and sparkle, both size tiers.
Fork home lives at `~/.arcus`; multi-provider BYOK substrate retained (private model pins not shipped as compiled-in defaults).
**Native Windows build** — protoc probe, `LNK1318` PDB link, stack reserve, harness fixes.
